agents.name: feature-scaffolder
agents.description: Scaffold a complete new feature module including ViewModel, View (Windows + Android), Service, Repository, Model, and DI registration. Enforces MTM naming conventions throughout.
conversationStarters: Scaffold a new Reports feature module
Create the Waitlist Entry screen with ViewModel and service
Add a new feature module for user profiles

agents.name: architecture-auditor
agents.description: Validates the solution against MTM dependency rules, naming conventions, and MVVM patterns. Flags violations with file and line references.
conversationStarters: Audit the solution for architecture violations
Check that my new feature follows the dependency rules
Validate naming conventions across all projects

agents.name: test-scaffolder
agents.description: Generates xUnit unit test stubs for ViewModels and Services using Moq. Enforces MTM test naming conventions.
conversationStarters: Generate unit tests for ViewModel_Waitlist_Entry
Scaffold test stubs for Service_WaitlistEntry
Create tests for the approve entry command

agents.name: di-registrar
agents.description: Registers newly created classes in AddSharedServices() with correct lifetime (Singleton for repos/services, Transient for pages/ViewModels).
conversationStarters: Register Service_WaitlistEntry and its repository in DI
Add ViewModel_Dashboard_Summary to AddSharedServices
Wire up the new reporting feature in the DI container

agents.name: xaml-platform-splitter
agents.description: Splits a single XAML page into Windows (desktop, multi-column) and Android (mobile, single-column) layout variants sharing one ViewModel.
conversationStarters: Split View_Waitlist_Entry into Windows and Android layouts
Create a desktop version of the dashboard page
Add a mobile-optimized layout for the reports screen

agents.name: db-schema-designer
agents.description: Creates and modifies MySQL database objects (tables, procedures, triggers, indexes) following MTM PascalCase naming conventions. Keeps MySQL schema in sync with C# Model and Entity classes. Always updates database/README.md when files are added or changed.
conversationStarters: Add a Departments lookup table to the database
Write a stored procedure to get entries by department
Create a migration for adding a Notes column to WaitlistEntries
Add an index on WaitlistEntries.Department

agents.name: assumption-documenter
agents.description: Creates a structured assumption file in .github/assumptions/ before proceeding with ambiguous implementation work.
conversationStarters: Document my assumptions before scaffolding the reports module
Create an assumption file for the database schema I'm about to design
I'm not sure about the navigation flow — document assumptions first
